name: donext
description: The to-do list you can talk to: voice input, smart suggestions, reminders with sound, shared lists and offline sync. React + TypeScript, Node/Express, MongoDB, PWA, iOS/Android. Live demo, no sign-up.

paragraphs: The to-do list you can talk to. DoNext is a mobile-friendly, offline-first, open-source task app by DewanTech™. It has voice input, shared lists and offline sync, and is packaged for iOS and Android.
▶ Try the live demo: no sign-up, nothing to install. Tap "Try it instantly".
Built by Dewan Mahmud · DewanTech™: Technology Built with Purpose.
features: Offline-first sync engine: every change is saved to IndexedDB and queued in an outbox, then synced with last-write-wins conflict resolution and deletion tombstones. The app works fully without a connection.

Understands plain language, on the device: type or say "milk eggs and bread tomorrow 6pm" and it suggests Buy groceries, the Groceries category, a due date and time, and Milk, Eggs and Bread as sub-items. It's…
Voice input and spoken reminders: speech-to-text with permission handling, and reminders that play a synthesised sound (Web Audio) and can be read aloud (Speech Synthesis).
Collaboration: shared lists with email invitations and assignees. Access rules are enforced on the server and covered by tests.
Security: bcrypt, revocable JWTs, strict Zod schemas that block NoSQL injection, Helmet CSP and rate limiting.

requirements.text: Accounts: sign up, log in, log out, log out of all devices, forgot/reset password by email, edit your name, change your password, download all your data as JSON, and delete your account (asks for your password again).
They get an email, and see the invitation when they log in or after they sign up with that address.
